title: Deep learning separates premalignant from benign colorectal polyps on CT colonography
summary: Two 3D deep learning models were trained on 107 polyps from 63 patients and tested on an external multicentre sample of 77 polyps in 59 patients. The model trained with segmentation masks reached ROC-AUC 0.83 (80% sensitivity at 69% specificity), and the model without segmentation reached AUC 0.75 (80% sensitivity at 44% specificity), with Grad-CAM++ visualization. The authors describe it as a proof-of-concept study.
ai_technology: 3D convolutional deep learning models on CT colonography subvolumes with Grad-CAM++
